calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ds.store_id,
  ds.store_name,
  ds.sqm,
  SUM(COALESCE(rdss.net_sales, 0)) AS total_net_sales
FROM dim_store ds
LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales rdss ON ds.store_id = rdss.store_id
WHERE ds.is_current = true AND ds.store_id < 900
GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.sqm
ORDER BY total_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ds.store_id,
  ds.store_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rdss.business_date) as sales_days_recorded
FROM dim_store ds
LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales rdss ON ds.store_id = rdss.store_id
WHERE ds.is_current = true AND ds.store_id < 900
GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name
ORDER BY sales_days_recorded DESC
LIMIT 15;

ORDER BY total_net_sales_eur DESC
